name: Japan Elevator Service Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Japan Elevator Service Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides repair, maintenance, and modernization services for elevators and escalators in Japan. The company offers maintenance plan such as full maintenance contract and parts, oil, and grease contract; one time modernization plan offers traction machine, control panel, and hydraulic unit; maintenance of mechanical parking equipment; and media business for elevators. In addition, the company provides LiftSPOT, a digital signage system equipped with security cameras; and remote inspection service, including remote diagnosis and monitoring under the name PRIME.
